title: Silas and the Spire
author: O. M. Eriksen
blurb: Lena Delacroix, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
